finding: Uterine niche was detected by hysteroscopy in 75% of women with a previous caesarean section, while no disruptions were observed in women without a previous caesarean section.
mod_finding: In a prospective cohort study among women undergoing hysteroscopic sterilization, uterine niche was detected by hysteroscopy in 75% of women with a previous cesarean section, but not in women without a prior cesarean section.
